worddael.metric: gold answer span contained in retrieved chunk from the correct original document; original CMRC labels; not generated-answer quality
worddael.model: BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via FastEmbed CPU ONNX, fixed for every splitter

helan.labels: independent deterministic injection; NOT human labels or real customer PII
helan.report_scope: typed exact spans; no PERSON/ADDRESS/semantic PII claims

siftan.calibration: maximize F1 on calibration only; tie choose higher threshold; frozen before holdout

gewita.source_queries: at most 8 known real DOI works and arXiv metadata; cache raw responses; structured modified-year controls are synthetic
gewita.quote_alignment: real CMRC excerpts + deterministic normalization/negation transformations; negation is NOT human semantic annotation

honesty: Synthetic perturbation labels do not measure production accuracy
